Road closures, clearways and restricted access arrangements will be in place this New Year's Eve in Balmain, Rozelle, Birchgrove and Drummoyne in the Balmain Peninsula.

  • From 3pm road closures will be in place on sections of Darling St, Ballast Point Rd, Booth St, Brent St, Evan St, Grove St, Joseph St, Hartley St, Hanover St, Loughlin St, Mackenzie St, Mansfield St, McKell St, Mullens St, Rose St, Terry St, The Crescent, Waragal Ave, Wharf Rd and Yeend St.

Special event clearways are in effect on Victoria Rd from The Crescent, Rozelle to Westbourne St, Drummoyne (western side) from 3pm NYE until 2am NYD. Clearways are strict no parking zones for all vehicle types, and apply even to local residents and businesses with parking permits or TfNSW Mobility Scheme permit holders. Road closures and restricted access arrangements will be in place as crowds gather to celebrate New Year's Eve in Kurraba Point.

From 5pm NYE to 3am 1 Jan the following roads into Kurraba Point will close. Access will be maintained by traffic control for residents only until 8pm. After 8pm no vehicle access permitted.

  • Kurraba Rd from Wycombe Rd,
  • Wallaringa Ave from Lower Wycombe Rd
  • Shellcove Rd from Harriette St

Special event clearways will be in effect on nearby major roads including Falcon St and Military Rd from Neutral Bay through to Mosman from 3pm NYE until 3am NYD.

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types, and apply even to local residents and TfNSW Mobility Scheme Permit holders. Check signs carefully as vehicles left in signposted clearways will be towed and a fee applies. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.
